title: Give Text-Only AI Agents Eyes with This Open-Source Toolkit
description:
Agent-vision-toolkit is a free toolkit that lets text-only AI models understand images and screenshots. It gives you tools for image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, and frontend UI restoration. Install it with one sentence.
